options.blogdescription: Full WooCommerce storefront with inventory management and weight-based shipping

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( class_exists( 'WC_Product_Simple' ) ) {
	$seed = array(
		array( 'sku' => 'NL-CAS-1142', 'name' => 'Alloy 11-Speed Cassette (11-42T)', 'price' => '74.00', 'stock' => 28, 'weight' => '0.44' ),
		array( 'sku' => 'NL-BRK-4P180', 'name' => 'Hydraulic Disc Brake Set', 'price' => '189.00', 'stock' => 14, 'weight' => '1.15' ),
		array( 'sku' => 'NL-WHL-700G', 'name' => '700c Tubeless Gravel Wheelset', 'price' => '349.00', 'stock' => 7, 'weight' => '2.35' ),
		array( 'sku' => 'NL-CHN-11WX', 'name' => 'Pre-Waxed 11-Speed Chain', 'price' => '36.50', 'stock' => 64, 'weight' => '0.27' ),
	);
	foreach ( $seed as $item ) {
		if ( wc_get_product_id_by_sku( $item['sku'] ) ) {
			continue;
		}
		$product = new WC_Product_Simple();
		$product->set_name( $item['name'] );
		$product->set_sku( $item['sku'] );
		$product->set_regular_price( $item['price'] );
		$product->set_manage_stock( true );
		$product->set_stock_quantity( $item['stock'] );
		$product->set_weight( $item['weight'] );
		$product->set_status( 'publish' );
		$product->save();
	}
}
flush_rewrite_rules( true );
